thread:
maria: Heads-up — running a mid‑quarter least‑privilege sampling tomorrow morning. Target ~200 identities across prod + staging. Focus windows: kms-admin, svcacct high-perms, and any cross‑acct grants. Need infra + oncall signoff.
ajay: +1. Can we make sure audit logs are stitched to the owner map before we run? I can do the mapping if someone gives me the last ingestion window.
devon: pinging oncall @olivia — last sweep missed a couple cross‑acct grants because the logshipper dropped events.
olivia: oncall here. I can run the log pull at 09:30 PST and validate ingestion. Share the exact query/filters you want.
maria: perfect. use this filter (start/end will be injected by the job):
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, action, resource, timestamp
FROM kms_audit_events
WHERE action ILIKE '%grant%'
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '{{start}}' AND '{{end}}'
  AND resource NOT LIKE 'arn:aws:iam::{{own_account}}:%' -- surface cross‑account
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
```
also please join on owners table (owner_email) and mark any rows with NULL owner as ownerless.
ajay: i pushed a tiny helper to speed this: `scripts/kms_owner_map.py --start 2026-03-24 --end 2026-03-24 --out /tmp/kms_map.csv` — PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kms-scripts/pull/142 (small diff).
devon: quick reminder — include entitlement justification column from entitlements DB. Ownerless + admin perms = immediate remediation flag.
maria: right — remediation plan: owners get TTL'd into a 7‑day temp elevation if they request; otherwise we revoke admin first then open a remediation ticket. who can own the remediations queue?
sam: happy to own the top 20 highest‑risk cases (ownerless or cross‑acct admin). I'll coordinate with oncall for re‑ingestion.
olivia: noted. i'll run the pull and validate ingestion, then drop the csv to /var/tmp/kms_sampling/ and ping sam.
security-bot: scheduled job created — sampling-job/87342 queued for 2026-03-24T16:30:00Z (invoked by maria).
maria: thanks all. I'll add the checklist to the runbook and post results back to #eng-security after the run. Please annotate any surprises with an evidence link (audit ID or S3 path). :thumbsup:
